.ends ptap1

.param R=0 w=0 l=0 TC1=0.00353 TC2=0

.subckt rsil 1 2 bn
.param w=0.5e-6 l=0.5e-6 mm_ok=1 b=0 m=1 trise=0 sw_et=0
+postsim=0
+kappa=1.85
+ps=0.18e-6

+lhead=0.86e-6

+p0=leff+lhead+w-(postsim>0)*px*1e-6
+p=(p0>0)*p0
+rshspec=7
+rqrc=4.5e-6
+rz=rzspec/w-(postsim>0)*rqrc/w

NR1 1 bn 2 dt rmod_rsil L=leff W=weff m=m
+a1=a a2=a
+p1=p p2=p
+c1=1 c2=1
+trise=trise
+sw_et=sw_et
+sw_mman=1
+nsmm_rsh=1 ; number of standard deviations for rsh
+nsmm_w=1   ; number of standard deviations for w
+nsmm_l=1   ; number of standard deviations for l

.model rmod_rsil r3_cmc
+rsh=rsh_rsil
+ecrit=1000
+dfinf=1e-4
+dp=1000
+xw=0.01
+rc=rz
+ca=cax
+cp=cpx
